description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Notification in terms of Section 192 of the Civil Procedure Code to determine the Legal Rate of Interest with effect from 01st January 2021.
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the determination of the Legal Rate of Interest by the Monetary Board, as authorized by an amendment to the Civil Procedure Code. The content pertains to a regulatory matter (setting an official interest rate) based on statutory authority, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
